title: Robes
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.182 Numbered Discourses 5.182
  • 19. Araññavagga 19. Wilderness Dwellers

Cīvarasutta Robes

“Pañcime, bhikkhave, paṁsukūlikā. “Mendicants, these five wear rag robes. Katame pañca? What five? Mandattā momūhattā paṁsukūliko hoti …pe… idamatthitaṁyeva nissāya paṁsukūliko hoti. One may wear rag robes because of stupidity … corrupt wishes … madness … because it is praised by the Buddhas … or for the sake of having few wishes … Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca paṁsukūlikā”ti. These are the five who wear rag robes.”

Dutiyaṁ.
